richText: A dependency is a library that the application needs. The classpath is the set of classes and libraries available to the application.
A starter is a dependency that brings in a related set of libraries. It is not a project template.
For Spring Boot 3, spring-boot-starter-web includes Spring MVC and an embedded Tomcat server by default.
spring-boot-starter-data-jpa provides Spring Data JPA and Hibernate. A database driver is a separate dependency.
Use Spring Boot’s dependency management to choose compatible library versions. Do not independently version each starter.

example.title: Add the Spring Web starter
description: Add this dependency inside the dependencies element of a Spring Boot 3 Maven project. Keep its generated parent or dependency-management configuration.
explanation: Maven resolves the starter and the libraries it depends on.
The starter adds libraries; auto-configuration determines which Spring configuration applies.
